tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Find a guide for client setup, API requests, SDK/CLI usage, authentication or lookup safety. Returns IDs, URLs and excerpts; pass a matching ID to read_documentation for the complete guide.

tools.name: read_documentation
tools.description: Read the complete guide for a known document ID. Returns Markdown and its source URL. Find IDs with search_documentation or resources/list.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_documentation" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find official instructions for connecting the MCP server, querying the API, using the SDK or CLI, authentication, and travel-power lookup safety. Returns document IDs, URLs and excerpts; use read_documentation for the full document." → after: "Find a guide for client setup, API requests, SDK/CLI usage, authentication or lookup safety. Returns IDs, URLs and excerpts; pass a matching ID to read_documentation for the complete guide."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
